'''Kolanda Station''' was located on [[Latharra]]<ref name="Gamer5" /> in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the site of a [[Massacre at Kolanda Station|massacre]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldiers by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces acting on intelligence supplied by [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Gamer5" />
